Definitely a Good Choice!
Apr 2024 • Couples
We went in last night and my husband had a grilled fish and I had a beef and noodle bowl. Both excellent, loved the mint in the noodles but wanted a little more. We noticed they had pizza on the menu and some great reviews so we decided that, after 4 weeks of Vietnamese food, it was time for a change. We came back the next night and ordered a Caribbean pizza and a salad and were blown away by how good the pizza was! Proper cheese, lovely thin crust, delicious! The prices are good and the staff are so friendly and attentive they make it a pleasure to go in. Absolutely recommend for either local dishes or pizza.

A bit of everything
Oct 2023 • Friends
The place has a small terrace and a small dining room, and is moderately clean.

Fast and attentive service.

We ordered several dishes and the truth is that they were pretty good, although not spectacular.

The prawns were good but bland, the oysters were good, the fries were also good and the pizzas were very good, the dough and ingredients were not bad.

We ordered several juices and smoothies that were pretty good.

The truth is that on the menu there was everything: pizzas, hamburgers, seafood, vegan dishes, some Vietnamese...
, and there was even potato omelette for those nostalgic for Spanish food and quite successful.

The truth is that the site is quite good so I recommend it.
